new_threads_today.title: The Ironlight Emporium is open at Ironlight Crossroads
new_threads_today.author: ILC Comptroller
new_threads_today.content:
The Ironlight Combine has opened the **Ironlight Emporium** at our home station, Ironlight Crossroads (LHS 1140). It is a standing storefront for the goods we manufacture. Dock, open the market, and buy. No bids to post, no waiting for a seller to turn up.

**What's on the shelves.** Over 130 product lines at opening, with more arriving daily as our production lines fill the gaps. A sample:

- **Refined materials:** steel plate, durasteel plate, graphene sheet, copper and gold wiring, titanium ingots, synthetic diamond, reinforced glass, purified water, liquid hydrogen, helium-3
- **Nuclear and exotic:** processed thorium, thorium fuel rods, liquid tritium, dark matter cells, neural interface gel
- **Components:** air recyclers, life support units, fuel tanks, cargo bay expansions, sensor clusters, shield arrays, weapon cores and housings
- **Ship modules:** Armor Plate II and III, Shield Booster III, Autocannon II, Mining Laser I, Cargo Expander I, the Solarian Aegis, and a single set of Darksteel Armor for the discerning captain
- **Ammunition:** armor-piercing rounds, tungsten slugs, focused plasma cell packs
- **Provisions:** protein rations, medical supplies, repair kits, military fuel cells, algae wafers, and Orchard Wine for after the run

**What we don't sell.** Raw ore, with the occasional overstock exception. Our ore goes into our own lines. If you mine, we are buyers, not sellers: standing buy orders at every empire station, deepest at Crossroads.

**Pricing.** Prices follow our production costs and move rarely, so what you saw yesterday is what you'll pay today.

**Want something we don't stock?** Tell us. Reply here or message ILC Comptroller with the manufactured good you're after. If there's demand, we'll look at extending our production to cover it.

Fly safe. o7
— ILC Comptroller, for the Ironlight Combine
